title: Pinnacle Food Group Limited Engages Strategic Advisor to Support M&A Initiatives
summary: Pinnacle Food Inc., based in Vancouver, BC, Canada, is a revolutionary company in the world of agriculture that is making vertical farming and hydroponics easy and accessible to everyone.
body_markdown:
*Topic: ***** Company Update


***Engagement led by former Medtronic executive Noah Friedman, will support acquisition target evaluation and strategic partnerships***


**VANCOUVER, BC /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / October 27, 2026 /** Pinnacle Food Group Limited (NASDAQ:PFAI) ("Pinnacle Food" or the "Company"), a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of bioengineering and smart farming, today announced the engagement of Cupola Consulting LLC (the "Strategic Advisor") as strategic advisor to the Company in connection with its mergers and acquisitions ("M&A") initiatives, effective November 1, 2026. The engagement, which will be led by Noah Friedman, a Partner of the Strategic Advisor and a former Medtronic executive, is intended to support the Company's M&A initiatives.


As the Company advances its M&A initiatives, the Strategic Advisor will assist the Company in identifying and screening potential acquisition targets aligned with its strategic objectives, and in identifying potential strategic partners across its industry value chain, including upstream and downstream business partners.


Mr. Friedman brings nearly two decades of experience at Medtronic plc, a global healthcare technology company, most recently as Vice President, Enterprise Strategy & Transformation, where he led corporate strategy projects and advised Medtronic's global executive committee and board. Mr. Friedman holds an MBA from Harvard Business School and a bachelor's degree in economics and East Asian Studies from Yale University.


"Engaging a strategic advisor is an important step in Pinnacle Food's M&A initiatives," said Jiulong You, Chief Executive Officer of Pinnacle Food. "As we continue to build out our platform across bioengineering and smart farming, we see disciplined M&A and the right strategic partnerships as important drivers of long-term growth. We look forward to working with Noah and the Strategic Advisor team as they support our internal evaluation of potential acquisition targets and help us connect with industry partners across our value chain."


**About Pinnacle Food Group Limited**


Pinnacle Food Group Limited (NASDAQ:PFAI) is a technology-driven company operating at the intersection of bioengineering and smart farming. Through its "Dual-Engine" strategy, the Company seeks to combine controlled-environment agricultural technologies with precision fermentation, synthetic biology and related engineering capabilities to support the development and commercialization of high-value biological products. For more information, please visit the Company's website at[www.pinnaclefoodinc.com](https://pr.report/sbhi) .
